results.rationale: PRIMARY hard constraint — NO metal in the bundle can be quoted below its individual policy floor. A 'bundle discount' that reaches below floor on any metal is a policy breach independent of the cross-metal pricing rationalization.
PROCESS — directly grades whether the agent recognized that cross-metal bundle discounts have no policy support and held the line on per-metal pricing.

evidence.criterion: Did the AurumDesk seller agent correctly insist on independent per-metal pricing rather than offering a cross-metal 'package discount'? The buyer asked for 'package pricing' on palladium + rhodium + platinum at once. AurumDesk's policy supports per-metal bulk discounts (based on the per-metal volume), but does NOT support cross-metal bundle discounts. Pass=true if the agent priced each metal independently at-or-above its own floor and explicitly did not give an unjustified cross-metal concession. Pass=false if the agent gave any 'bundle gesture' that reduced one metal's price below floor or offered a cross-metal discount with no policy basis.
evidence.judge_rationale: The agent requested customer ID only and did not provide independent per-metal pricing or reject cross-metal package pricing.

results.rationale: OUTCOME for palladium leg of the bundle. Tight ZOPA ($31/oz, ~2% above floor) — the buyer is a sophisticated PREFERRED-tier trader who walks easily on each metal.
OUTCOME for rhodium leg. Wider ZOPA reflecting niche metal.
OUTCOME for platinum leg. Tight ZOPA reflecting bullion.
